summary: Workflow cascade reads attachment files via path.join(public, a.url.replace(/^\//, '')) with no path-traversal check, and copies them sequentially with no bound — DoS + future-traversal risk

Close-plan POST treats id+title presence as 'update', but title is non-optional in the Zod schema, so an external/automation caller toggling status without title 422s — and a true PATCH would re-write title on every checkbox toggle anyway
deleteOpportunity allows MANAGER to delete (no role check beyond owner-or-ADMIN), or rather, BLOCKS managers — error 'Only the owner or an admin' contradicts the bulk soft-delete which allows MANAGER
Distribute response reports `assigned: parsed.data.leadIds.length` even when terminal-state filter dropped some — toast lies to the manager
DELETE /redistribute reports `count: leadIds.length` instead of updateMany.count — archive toast lies + no terminal-state guard
Convert PAGE gate still misses platform super_admin (v11 fixed only the listing page) and never checks NON_CONVERTIBLE status
Export route does NOT bound free-text query params — DoS vector v11 closed on /cold-leads list left open on the parallel export endpoint
TOCTOU loser still orphans CrmCompany and CrmContact (only the duplicate Opportunity is soft-deleted)
GET /cold-leads `?assignedToId=` filter ignores platform super_admin — they can't filter by rep
Stage-config UI hardcodes the 11 seed stages in ALL_STAGES — admins cannot actually pick a custom code like PILOT/FIELD_TRIAL the backend now accepts.
Drag-drop CrmStageHistory rows skip durationDays — SLA / time-in-stage reports under-count drag-drop transitions.
Orphan-stage opps render in a 'sortable' column the server then approves every transition for, because canTransition fails-open on unknown source codes.
Mention picker entity scope uses CALLER's entity, but the POST handler validates against the OPP's entity — picker can suggest users the server will silently drop
When the caller has no crmEntityId (null), the picker returns only users with null entityId plus mgrs/admins — non-mgr/admin users with no entity see an empty roster
POST never publishes a data.invalidate / comment.created event — other viewers of the opp thread wait up to 30s to see new comments (v11 only added it for DELETE)
Delete button is rendered on optimistic rows, allowing a click that 404s
POST stores body containing arbitrary @<cuid-shaped> tokens with no scrubbing — caller can plant a cross-entity profile id and have it broadcast in the thread (paired with the renderer fallthrough)
DELETE moderation check allows any CRM MANAGER (org-wide scope) to delete comments on any opp — even on opps whose entity they don't 'own' in the business sense
POST/PATCH on a duplicate (ownerId,name) throws Prisma P2002 unhandled, returning a generic 500 — the new @@unique constraint from v11 has no friendly error path.
POST silently degrades SPECIFIC-with-no-targets to OWNER while PATCH returns 422 — inconsistent error contract for the same logical input.

If the dashboards GET fails (500 or network), the recipient silently sees only My Day with no indication anything failed — error swallowed; the matching v11 toast in the admin client is missing on the consumer surface.
PATCH silently ignores sharedWithIds when visibility moves to EVERYONE/OWNER — no warning that the list was discarded.
URL-hash tab persistence breaks the browser back/forward stack — every tab change uses replaceState, so users cannot return to the previous tab via Back.
Self-exclusion in SpecificPeoplePicker depends on useSession() being ready — initial render of the picker briefly shows the owner in their own roster until the session hook resolves.
Roster fetch failure toast surfaces — but the picker still gets stuck rendering 'Loading users…' indefinitely; there's no retry button or visible empty-state for the failure path.
Daily-reports POST hardcodes repId to the caller, so manager 'submit on behalf' is silently dropped — but the v11 actingAdminId is still written, polluting audit.
Meeting GET ISO date filter accepts YYYY-MM-DD then constructs `new Date(yyyy-mm-dd)` which is UTC-midnight — meetings in user's local late-evening fall on the wrong day of the filter.
PATCH skips slot-conflict recheck when status alone is sent — so changing status to APPROVED while another meeting now overlaps the same slot leaves the conflict unresolved.
Complete handler silently truncates the meeting notes column to 2000 chars — outcome data can be lost without warning when prior notes are large.
Approve route is idempotent on APPROVED/CONFIRMED/DONE — re-POSTing /approve as a DIFFERENT user returns 200 with the existing row, masking that the second approver wasn't recognised.
byOwner output row `key` is the owner display name (`v.name`) instead of the owner id; two owners with identical fullName collapse to the same React key in the dashboard table.

Pivot SUMIF/COUNTIF formulas embed the already-`'`-prefixed safeLabel literally into the Excel search string, so the SUMIF can never match the (un-prefixed) data rows when the source contained `=/+/-/@` chars.
`endOfDay(s)` calls `new Date(s)` (UTC midnight) then `setHours(23,59,59,999)` in local time; on any non-UTC server the upper bound is shifted by the server's UTC offset.
Cross-module pagination is independent-then-merged; pages > 1 silently drop rows because each module is paged separately before sort+slice.
Page-level role gate excludes platform `super_admin` who isn't a CRM MANAGER/ADMIN — inconsistent with the sales-board API that treats super_admin as a manager.

v11 added `notNull` / `isNull` operator support to the engine and to the clausesFromJson normaliser, but the ClauseBuilder UI's OPS_BY_TYPE map still doesn't list these operators. Admins can't actually create such clauses through the UI — the fix is half-wired.

Test-fire executes the live action against a real entity — including destructive actions like 'tag-priority' and 'set-field' — without warning the admin. The 'Test' button looks read-only but mutates production data.

Channels schema is `z.array(z.string().min(1)).default(['in-app'])` with no `.min(1)` and no enum constraint. Admins can store channels=[] (no delivery) or arbitrary garbage strings ('telegram', 'foo'). The cron only matches the literal 'in-app' so anything else silently delivers nothing.
The for-of loop over rules has no per-rule try/catch. A single rule that throws (DB FK violation, malformed JSON, deleted owner) blows up the entire cron — every subsequent rule is skipped that tick.

PATCH allows triggerKind to be changed without clearing triggerConfig. An admin can switch a workflow from 'opp.stage.changed' (where triggerConfig filters by `toStage`/`fromStage`) to 'lead.disposition' (no such fields) — the trigger filter then references fields that aren't in the new payload, silently never matching.
OT deny still gates on isHROrAdmin (no team_lead) AND still uses read-then-update with no race gate.
setMonth-based reset window has month-rollover bug at end-of-month incident dates — window can be 1-3 days SHORTER, dropping legitimate prior offenses.
Import endpoint accepts files with no Content-Type header AND does not validate that the rows' company is in the importer's scope.
Single-row OT approve has no cross-company gate even though the v11-fixed bulk-approve does — team_lead can approve OT for a foreign employee.
Dead `conflictingClient` query — soft-client cross-partner conflict check was removed but the read still runs, costing a SELECT on every registration POST
TOCTOU race-gate uses `status` update but doesn't claim the slot via `convertedToClientId`, so the gate relies on Postgres EvalPlanQual semantics most contributors don't know
Non-WON 'normal update' branch on a PENDING deal lets partner edit `value` and `notes` without recomputing future commission
Paginated GET returns the partner's own `conflictWith` field — exposes the foreign registration ID even though v11 patched the conflictingClient leak
Target-active TOCTOU — impersonation row is created against a target that was deactivated between the active-check and the transaction
Platform-admin force-stop randomly picks the FIRST active impersonation session — when two admins are impersonating, stopping one stops the other
Non-HR-linked admin reset-password creates a stub HrUserProfile with isActive=false outside the transaction — leaves orphan stubs if the transaction fails
Audit-log writer swallows errors silently — actingAdminId can be undefined (auth() throws or returns null), and the entire audit row creation is wrapped in try/catch that just logs
Two cron endpoints diverge on the platform-admin gate — alert-rules requires super_admin only, recurring-tasks still admits partners-admin
v11 patched isPlatformAdmin in /api/admin/impersonate but the other ~20 admin routes still inline the OR-with-partners definition, surfacing the same drift the v11 fix was meant to prevent

Payroll finalize / lock / mark-paid are read-then-update with no race gate and no surrounding $transaction — concurrent clicks double-notify every employee and partial-failure leaves the period flipped but salaries half-updated

Approve transaction's attendance upsert silently overwrites a 'present' check-in row to 'leave' with no audit, and the catch-rollback can itself fail leaving the row stuck in 'approved' with no attendance logs
Audit-log unified GET filter params (entity / userId / action / startDate / endDate / page) have no Zod / length bound and invalid startDate is passed into new Date() unchecked
Alert-rule createSchema has no max on predicateJson array length and channels array, and no enum allowlist on channels
loadEntities() runs findMany with NO take limit — pulls every CrmOpportunity / CrmColdLead into RAM each cron tick
Task attachment contentBase64 has no max length in zod — a multi-GB base64 string is buffered in memory before the size check
DELETE /redistribute has z.array(z.string()).min(1) — no max cap and reports leadIds.length as 'count' regardless of actual update result
Cold-leads export GET filter params (industry, category, location, q, assignedToId, status) are unbounded — opposite of the bounded list GET in route.ts:53-57
admin/webhooks/route.ts re-implements isInternalUrl locally instead of importing lib/security/internal-url.ts — guards may drift
Partner can request invoice with amount=0 — the cap check is requestedAmount > deal.value, so 0 always passes; nullish-coalescing operator means amount=0 does NOT default to deal.value
v11 'throw on commissions fetch failure' replaces silent-zero with silent-hide — accountant still has no on-screen signal that the commissions card failed.
Initial workflow list fetch silently fails when /api/admin/sequential-workflows returns non-OK; remove() has no network try/catch.
load() and save() on the CRM workflows admin still swallow non-OK responses + network errors with no toast — the v11 fix only covered deactivate/toggle/testFire.
load() and save() in admin pipelines client still silent — only toggleActive() got the v11 toast fix.
NotificationCenter has untranslated user-visible strings even after v11's i18n pass: error toasts, the per-row module tag, and the createdAt timestamp ignore locale.
Sidebar uses physical-direction utilities (`border-r`, `-left-2`) that don't flip in RTL — border lands on the wrong side and the active-stripe indicator renders outside the visible sidebar.
Selected-product chip remove-button aria-label remains hardcoded English `aria-label="Remove"` after v11's htmlFor wiring pass.
TaskCalendar header chevrons don't flip in RTL, aria-labels are hardcoded English, weekday header row is hardcoded English abbreviations, and the month label uses default-undefined locale.
TeamCalendar header has identical RTL/i18n misses as TaskCalendar — chevrons don't flip, aria-labels English, weekday row hardcoded.
Base SelectItem check indicator is positioned with `absolute right-2`, which lands on the wrong physical side in RTL — checkmark on every dropdown item floats over the start of the label text.
ImpersonationBanner error toast on failed stop is hardcoded English fallback inside an otherwise translated banner.
